info.title: WANX Octop · zhijun
info.description:
**CentaurAI-WANX** is a smarter, self-hosted AI assistant for multiple users and agents. All routes are served under `/api`.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a JWT bearer token:

1. Complete initial setup via `/api/setup/*` (first install only).
2. `GET /api/auth/captcha` then `POST /api/auth/login` with `username` and `password`
   (and `captcha_token` when a strong provider is active), or complete SSO with
   `/api/auth/oidc/*` or `/api/auth/oauth/*` when a provider is enabled.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on subsequent requests.

Access tokens use sliding renewal: when less than one-third of
`access_token_ttl_seconds` remains, authenticated responses may include a fresh
token in the `X-Octop-Access-Token` header. Clients should replace the stored
token when present.

Public endpoints (no login token): `/api/docs`, `/api/openapi.json`, `/api/health`,
`/api/setup/*` (wizard authorization applies), `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`,
`/api/auth/captcha`, `/api/auth/oidc/status`, `/api/auth/oidc/start`,
`/api/auth/oidc/callback`, `/api/auth/oidc/exchange`, `/api/auth/oauth/status`,
`/api/auth/oauth/start`, `/api/auth/oauth/callback`, `/api/auth/oauth/exchange`,
`/api/auth/invite/validate`,
`/api/auth/invite/redeem`, `/api/connectors/oauth/callback`,
and `/api/internal/mcp/*`.

## Agent scope

Many agent-scoped routes use the agent ID in the URL path (`/api/agents/{agent_id}/…`).
Routes first check the signed token's application scope; legacy tokens default to WANX.
Resources in another application are treated as not found, including for administrators.
Within the same application, each route applies its ownership or shared-resource access
rules. WANX administrators may bypass ownership where supported; Zhijun personal profiles,
memories and uploaded sources require the owner.

## Streaming chat

Dashboard live turns use **WebSocket** at `/api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/ws` (pass JWT as
`?token=` query param). Send `{"type":"user_turn", ...}` frames; the server replies with JSON
chunks matching the harness stream format, ending with `{"type":"done"}` or
`{"type":"error","message":"..."}`.

Text-type dashboard pushes (cron reminders, proactive care) also emit
`{"type":"dashboard_push", ...}` on `/api/notifications/ws` (same `?token=` auth) so the
SPA can show a toast even when the chat socket is not subscribed.

HITL resume still uses `POST /api/agents/{agent_id}/chat/hitl/resume` (SSE).

## Knowledge libraries

`/api/knowledge-bases` uses the signed application scope for creation, visibility,
document access, and citations. Existing libraries remain in WANX. Zhijun libraries
are private to their owner and use local document parsers, downloaded native ONNX
embeddings and RapidOCR. Remote WANX embedding/OCR settings do not affect Zhijun;
missing local components are reported as unavailable without remote fallback.

get.description: Owner-only policy over existing channels. Unmarked or rebound destinations default to work; credentials are never returned.

schema.title: Response Notification Channels Api Zhijun Notification Channels Get

put.summary: Declare an owned destination private or work
put.description: Records notification authorization in the owned profile workspace, bound to current channel credentials. Does not modify or reconnect the channel.

get.summary: Read my decisions, expectations and outcome reviews
get.description: Uses only the signed-in owner's isolated profile. Does not infer decisions from conversation or native memory.

post.summary: Record a choice and an agreed revisit time
post.description: Version-checked explicit owner entry. Private by default; only the separately supplied approved summary can enter private-destination reminders. No model is invoked.

post.summary: Compare a decision's result with its original expectation
post.description: Owner/revision checked. Preserves the original expectation and source sensitivity; review cannot relabel a private source or authorize its disclosure.

get.summary: Read my archived memories and operation status

post.summary: Archive or permanently remove my selected memory
post.description: Owner operation only. Checks the preview version and archives before removal. Does not delete conversation messages, source files, or external backups. No model is invoked.

post.summary: Preview removal of a memory and its direct derivatives
Restore or purge an archived memory
post.description: Restores original IDs without overwriting concurrent changes; purge removes the application's recovery copy. Archive identity is resolved within the signed-in owner's isolated profile.

get.summary: Read my document-understanding scope, progress and invitations
get.description: Zhijun login only. Validates current source versions; never starts reading, inference or messages. Only the signed-in owner's isolated profile is used.

put.summary: Choose owned libraries and opt into ongoing understanding
put.description: Version-checked owner settings. Library attribution does not recognize its contents as the owner's beliefs. New libraries require selection; a model call is not made by this request.

post.summary: Start or resume bounded reading of my selected libraries
post.description: Schedules one serialized background job per profile using its configured conversation model. Returns persisted progress, not a promise of complete reading. Existing successful pages are retained across retries.

post.summary: Pause ongoing document understanding without deleting progress
post.description: Stops subsequent reading batches and reminder attempts. In-flight output cannot commit across the new settings revision. Keeps memory and owner edits.

post.summary: Accept, postpone or dismiss a source-grounded invitation
post.description: Checks owner, revision and current source. Acceptance binds background only; does not fabricate a human message or confirm a personal belief. Postponement lasts one day.

post.summary: Open or resume an owned material invitation conversation
post.description: Validates source and profile ownership, then reuses a stable dedicated thread. Does not send messages, call a model or reset the current session. Reading and discussion never confirm a personal belief.

get.description: Requires a Zhijun-scoped login. Never creates a profile or lists WANX Agents.

post.summary: Create or recover my blank Zhijun profile
post.description: Idempotently returns the owner's unique profile. Only behavior rules are seeded; personal memory and conversation history start empty. No model conversation is run. A failed model start retains the same profile; retry attempts to start it again.

post.summary: Suggest possible responses to my latest Zhijun reply
post.description: Uses the profile's configured model and owned recent conversation. Only already-read sources participate; no tools run and no candidates are written to history or memory. A changed conversation returns stale. Model failure returns unavailable for explicit retry.

get.summary: Read my personal ontology and verify its sources
get.description: Zhijun login only. Reads the owner's sole profile; never runs a model. Native source changes invalidate affected understandings.

post.summary: Synthesize tentative life principles from my memory
post.description: Explicit request using this profile's configured model. Paginates all active memories, processing bounded incremental batches with saved coverage. Only verified owner quotations enter the prompt; repeated messages in one conversation/day are one support. Saves a local profile projection; never modifies native memory or confirms a principle. Failures preserve the previous ontology.

post.summary: Review or withdraw an understanding of myself
post.description: An explicit owner decision on the last read revision. Confirmation requires current native evidence. Updates the application projection and reads back the saved result; does not change source memories.

post.summary: Add my own statement to my personal ontology
post.description: An explicit self-declaration needs no inferred evidence. Revision check and persisted readback; adds no native memory facts.

post.summary: Edit, disable or restore my understanding
post.description: Optimistic revision check. Keeps the previous version and sources; owner wording cannot be replaced by background synthesis. Restore creates a new revision rather than erasing history.

post.summary: Add my current fact, role, project or goal
post.description: Owner-declared personal context, saved through the profile workspace. No model call or source-memory rewrite. Includes version and persisted readback.

post.summary: Correct, scope, merge, stop using or restore my personal context
post.description: Target-version check; unrelated background progress does not conflict. Person/project merges require both target versions. Current context changes preserve historical source quotations. Purge removes this context and its links, retains native sources, and records a content-free suppression identity.

get.summary: See understandings actually supplied for my reply
get.description: An immutable context snapshot scoped to this owner's profile and thread. This records supplied inputs, not model reasoning. Historical snapshots remain historical after edits.

post.summary: Review a relation between my understandings
post.description: Checks the target relation version and current endpoints for understanding and context links. Background progress does not conflict; changed endpoints require rechecking. Never treats a structural source link as a causal conclusion.

post.summary: Record the origin of an assisted reply
post.description: Records that the editable draft began with a verified AI suggestion. It is excluded as independent experience evidence; sends no chat message.

get.description: Owned, paginated candidates. Reading does not approve an understanding or call a model.

post.summary: Confirm or adjust the exact understanding shown to its owner
post.description: Owner UI only. Checks item version and idempotency key. Models and legacy confirmation cannot grant core admission. Reads back saved state.

post.summary: Open an owned conversation about a candidate understanding
post.description: Binds the current candidate as system context to a dedicated owned thread. No human message is fabricated and no core admission is granted.

get.summary: Read my digital self draft, publication, access and usage

put.summary: Save, draft, publish, pause or withdraw my digital self
put.description: Owner-only optimistic version check and readback. Saving private content never publishes it. Publishing requires explicit recognition of every selected entry. AI drafting consumes the owner's model and sends only selected excerpts.

get.summary: Select current owner sources for a publication draft

post.summary: Try a saved draft without creating visitor memory
post.description: Runs the isolated publication model with no private harness prompts or tools. This consumes the owner's configured model.

post.summary: Review access, revoke a visitor or decide a real-person contact request

get.summary: Read a visitor's complete conversation and relationship memory
Discover voluntarily published digital selves on this host
get.description: Only reviewed discovery metadata is returned. Cross-device public discovery remains gated on the WANX SDK restricted visitor contract; network_status indicates that prerequisite.

get.summary: Read a published profile and actual local availability

post.summary: Request access or submit an introduction to the owner

get.summary: Read a cited current published excerpt
get.description: Requires access. Returns only reviewed publication text, never private source IDs, paths or workspace files. Withdrawn or stale sources are unavailable.

get.summary: Read my own digital-self conversation and pending request state

post.summary: Ask an authorized digital self a question
post.description: Owner-visible, idempotent request ID, checked history and publication versions. One concurrent visitor; daily quotas use server timezone. Only current published excerpts and this visitor's history enter inference. Unknown requests are not automatically resent.

delete.summary: Clear my consultation history and relationship memory
delete.description: Checked revision and readback; removes both parties' application view and future context. Cannot retract copies already seen or saved outside the application.

CreateZhijunProfileBody.description: Intentionally accepts no source Agent, workspace or memory path.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Last read ontology revision; stale requests never overwrite owner decisions.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: The latest visible assistant reply; verified against native history.

manual.title: Manual
manual.description: Explicitly request choices even without a final follow-up question.

version.title: Version
version.description: Exact preview version; rejects changed content.

OntologyContextNode.title: OntologyContextNode
OntologyContextNode.description: Current, source-bound context; native records remain the historical evidence.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: An editable first-person answer with concrete content from the current topic, not a generic confirmation or a statement the user has already made.

question.title: Question
question.description: The exact single question that will appear in the final natural reply.

status.title: Status
status.description: Candidate generation status; no history is written.

style.title: Style
style.default: 简洁、具体，先理解问题，再说明判断依据。

boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.default: 不代本人承诺合作、交易或私人事项。

local.title: Local
local.description: Whether the model endpoint is local to this host.

UnderstandingPublicState.title: UnderstandingPublicState
UnderstandingPublicState.description: Owner-facing status; delivery reservations remain private to the coordinator.

acknowledge_owner_visibility.title: Acknowledge Owner Visibility
acknowledge_owner_visibility.description: Visitor explicitly acknowledges that the owner can read this conversation and the configured model processes it.

assisted.title: Assisted
assisted.description: The human message originated from an editable AI suggestion and is not independent relationship evidence.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Use this ID for every chat and memory request.

state.title: State
state.description: Native startup state; creation can survive a failed start.

ZhijunProfile.title: ZhijunProfile
ZhijunProfile.description: Native Agent identity and lifecycle; no copied personal information.

profile.description: Null until the owner explicitly creates it.
